title: Vulcan failure investigation focuses on ‘inadequate fuel supply’ to booster engines
summary: United Launch Alliance said Wednesday that a preliminary review of flight data points to an inadequate supply of fuel to the Blue Origin-manufactured engines of its Vulcan rocket, rather than a problem with the engines themselves, as the reason Sunday's launch fell short of orbit with 40 Amazon Leo internet satellites aboard.

title: NASA’s Voyager 1 is one light-day from Earth
summary: NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft became the first human-made object to reach a distance of one light-day from Earth early Wednesday, crossing the threshold at 5:16:07 a.m. EST (10:16:07 UTC) as it sped away from the sun at nearly 38,000 mph.
